from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection with its citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's title")
    references_others: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites in its bibliography")
    cited_by_others: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper in their reference lists")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
